title: Dynamic field arrays
objective: Preserve field-array identity with fields[].id, controlled append/remove, and bounded dynamic inputs.
predict: After removing a middle row, the remaining input content must stay attached to the correct item.
expectedBehavior: Type unique values in three rows; remove the middle row. The remaining values must match their original logical items. Adding past eight rows must be disabled.
commonFailure: The starter uses key={index} and allows unlimited rows; reordering or deleting can shift user edits.
securityBoundary: Never accept arbitrary numbers of dynamic rows on the server; cap collection lengths and validate each nested item.
